name: Matthew Johnson
school: University of West Florida / Florida Institute for Human & Machine Cognition
title: Research Scientist, dual UWF/IHMC ISR appointment; IHMC coordinator for the joint ISR PhD program
department: Intelligent Systems and Robotics joint doctoral program; IHMC Human-Machine Teaming
fitReason: A university-linked HRI mentor with official UWF ISR faculty listing, independently confirmed dual appointment, and directed human-machine teaming work. His robot-AI evidence includes event-driven reinforcement learning transferred to actual aerial robots. The host is in Pensacola and institutional affiliation must not be confused with a guaranteed UWF-sponsored IHMC visit. Official UWF repository records independently identify Johnson as co-chair of a 2025 ISR PhD dissertation, supporting degree-program advising without implying conventional tenure status or visitor-host authority.

physicalEvidence.summary: The complete author-uploaded 2023 CTF paper uses PPO-based macro-action selection on actual IHMC WASP UAVs in a bounded capture-the-flag game. Trained strategies select high-level actions; low-level flight and safety routines are conventionally engineered. Table 2 reports eight wins and two ties in ten hardware trials, despite a conflicting 90% statement in the prose. The first author dates this project to May–August 2021, so hardware is historical. The full 2025 fan-out paper instead evaluates simulated robots in a JavaScript escape-room task. The February 2026 equipment grant describes planned acquisitions, not newly completed learned execution.
